code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Markers specify the repeated rectangular patch size by their associated color:
    # fill repeated 2x2 patterns for 4 and 8; 6 is a single-cell marker.
    sizes={4:(2,2),8:(2,2),6:(1,1)}
    for color,(h,w) in sizes.items():
        # locate exemplar marker and include its surrounding patch anchored at marker
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==color]
        if not pts: continue
        r0,c0=pts[0]
        # Search candidate patch placements of the same size entirely on ones, in all regions.
        # Patch corresponding to marker is centered when possible.
        ar=r0-(h//2); ac=c0-(w//2)
        for r in range(R-h+1):
            for c in range(C-w+1):
                if all(g[y][x] in (1,color) for y in range(r,r+h) for x in range(c,c+w)):
                    # recolor repeated patch motifs
                    for y in range(r,r+h):
                        for x in range(c,c+w): g[y][x]=color
    return g
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
